description.value:
Enforcing is known to be the most physically demanding aetherfont, primarily by virtue of its function. Enforcers use volatile ether, a charged form of ether that is only created once ether has been exerted in some fashion. Through a special muscle lining in their lungs, enforcers can breathe in volatile ether for immediate use. Due to its active properties, volatile ether is much more potent and capable in allowing its user to perform impressive feats of skill or magic. However, volatile ether is dangerous in large amounts to enforcers, and it is also difficult to store for extended periods of time so it is quickly expelled from the body.

Enforcer Focus Point Feature

Enforcers start with 1 focus point after their daily preparations, and lose all their focus points after an hour has passed without substantial physical or mental exertion, which typically involve skill checks, travel or any activity that would not count as rest.

Once per round, they can gain one focus point through the following methods in a non-trivial challenge. A trivial challenge is typically one that is at least 4 levels below the character’s level:

  • Successfully rolling a critical hit with an Attack action

  • Rolling a critical success on a skill check

  • Taking damage equal to a tenth of their maximum hit points or higher

Notably, these checks must have a critical outcome due to the roll; a guaranteed critical success or failure would not qualify. When you reach 10th level, you treat your focus points as if it were double their current amount, for the purpose of meeting focus point costs.

Enforcer Refocus

When Enforcers refocus, they usually practice physical or mental exertion for the approximate duration of Refocus in relation to their source of their focus points. Upon refocusing, they return to 1 focus point. If you select a feat that improves your Refocus, you can gain up to 3 focus points in a single turn.
